strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
A building out here...? It doesn't look like a base.
Shouldn't we spread out for now?
I think so too... I've got a bad feeling.
...All right, all units launch! Stand by at battle readiness.
Still, this is suspicious. Could it be... a ninja hideout?
Really!? Big Bro?
Now that you mention it... something might be there.
What!? Is that true, Commander Hazuki...?
Lady Romina, there is still hope...!
Whoa, hold it, hold it! I can't even get a word in!
Why would there be ninjas in a desert!?
Joe, don't jump to conclusions on your own. You're not Koji.
Yeah, yeah... Hey, Sayaka, what's that supposed to mean!?
...I don't know what to say.
Tetsuya's no good at this kind of thing.
Come on, there's no way ninjas would be in a place like this.
It's not even Japan.
...I see...
This is awkward.
There's just...no sense of tension.
Well, beats being gloomy, doesn't it?
Being too cheerful's a problem too.
Sorry about that. The three of us grew up on Mars.
Don't worry about it. Growing up in a colony... Huh!?
Commander! Enemies sighted!
What's that...!?
A type I've never seen... New model? Or another new enemy!?
Hmm, they've noticed. I wanted more forces... It can't be helped.
I'll show no mercy to anyone in my way...! Attack!
They're attacking!? Why Zeon mobile suits...?
Show, who's piloting those?
I don't know! I doubt Drake's army would team up with surface forces...
Made it! The ID code is... Wh-what...!?
Out with it, Commander. Nothing's gonna surprise us now.
...Meganoids...!
Impossible! They were wiped out on Mars in the last war...!
If they'd been wiped out, they couldn't appear here, could they?
Quit skulking around and show yourself!
Hehehe, there's no need for me to come out myself!
Watching from the sidelines, huh?
Then I'll just drag you down here!
It's too early to be surprised... Behold!
"Behold"... Who are they?
What, are they somebody special!?
...Those people... Could they be...?
Hm, those people can't be...
...That's it, now I remember...!
Ryoma, are they from that big battle with the Meganoids on Mars...
Looks like it. Those are Banjo Haran's assistants!
Very good. Now, you two, give them their reward.
Yes, Lady Mylene.
Yes, Lady Mylene.
Yes, Lady Mylene.
...Dammit, what is going on here... Are they being controlled...?
Can people really be controlled that easily?
Hahaha, behold! Improved even further since the last war,
the power of our mind-control device!
Commander Hazuki, from the pyramid-like structure,
an abnormal signal is being transmitted!
What does that mean?
If we crush the source, the control will break...
Yes... But the problem is which building it's coming from...
Hmph, then we just smash them all, one by one. Let's go!
Ugh... Mmm...
Are you all right, Beauty?
Looks like she's back to her senses.
...Huh? What...?
Are you all right? You were being controlled by the Meganoids.
Oh, now that you mention it...
In any case, please withdraw somewhere safe for now.
Okay!
Ugh...
It's me, Reika. Are you all right?
Are you okay?
Huh? Oh... I'm fine... I see, I was... by the Meganoids...
It's dangerous here. Please withdraw outside the combat zone.
Understood.
Is the pilot all right?
Mmm... Lemme sleep a little longer...
Hey, wake up, Toppo!
Looks like he was in dreamland...
Uh, mmm... *yawn*... What's going on?
N-no, it's... You're Totsuta Toda, right?
Name's Toppo. Nice to meetcha.
Leave this airspace at once and get somewhere safe.
Roger~!
Blast it, then I have no choice! It's still incomplete, but so be it.
That's... a new Zeon model!?
...This feeling...? Kamille!
Amuro, that's... a psycommu-equipped Newtype machine!
Who's piloting it!?
...Commencing attack...
That girl... I've seen her somewhere...
This feeling... Are you...there...? Judau...?
I see, the one Judau was separated from in the last war...
It's Ple, isn't it? Elpeo Ple...!
Unlike Banjo's assistants, that girl won't be freed
even if you destroy the device over there.
What does that mean...?
Are they controlling her some other way...?
(The device is still experimental... I can't say whether it'll work...)
Now then, it's time I played with you myself.
Whoa!? What!? A giant woman...!
Now that's a sight.
Geez, Mister! Is this any time to fool around!?
Whoa! She's super-duper huge! Show!
Wh-what is this...! A tiny Ferario I could understand, but...!
No doubt... A Meganoid enlarged by their own micromachine technology...
A Megaborg!
It seems Banjo hasn't arrived yet.
And after I went to the trouble of controlling his assistants...
My, my, just what do you take my assistants for...?
Hm, who's there...!?
Have you forgotten me, my lady? ...Then let me remind you!
Daitaaaaan, come heeeeere!!
Unidentified flying object closing fast...!?
No, this ID code is...!
For the world and its people, Daitarn 3 crushes the Meganoids' ambitions!
If you don't fear the brilliance of the sun... come and get me!
Daitarn 3...!?
It was meant to be scrapped under military pressure after Mars...!
Until the Meganoids' ambitions are utterly crushed, Daitarn won't die.
So the one they blew up was a fake?
Without beating around the bush, yes.
Now, Commander Mylene, my lovely assistants, under your mind control...
I'll be taking them back!
Though it took me a while to go fetch it from Mars.
Hehehe, the man Lady Koros kept nagging us never to underestimate...
I'll see just how good you are!
Koros... Koros, huh. ...I met her...!
What...? Banjo, you...
Don... Don Zauser is probably alive and well too.
...Commander Mylene! My fight starts again right here!
This time, every last one of you will vanish from this world...!
Silence! Banjo Haran!
I'll say it all I like! Come on! If you don't fear the brilliance of the sun!
Here I come!
For the Meganoid Empire, and Don Zauser's fame across the galaxy!
I, Commander Mylene, woman though I may be,
will not rest until I've defeated Daitarn 3!
Ugh, this is as far as I go.
Oh well. The experiment here produced more than enough results.
Running away!? Mylene!
Banjo Haran... Don't worry. That Daitarn is alive and well,
I've seen with my own eyes, no need to ask your old flame, Lady Koros.
Don't expect things to go your way next time.
Mylene! Give Don a message!
Tell him Banjo Haran will be paying him a visit soon...!
Ohohohoho... Farewell, then.
...Geez, they go quiet for a while, and this is what they're up to.
Haran? You're Banjo Haran, aren't you?
Ah, forgive me for not introducing myself.
You're of the Far East branch's Cyber Beast Force, now the Gandor Team...
Commander Kotaro Hazuki...correct?
Glad to see you're quick on the uptake.
The Meganoids' renewed invasion... It seems that's now an undeniable fact.
So we've got another enemy.
Aww, I wanna go back to Byston Well.
...I've got some information on the Meganoids.
Commander Hazuki, I'd like Daitarn 3 to tag along... Would that be all right?
Of course. I've heard tales of your heroics in the battle on Mars.
We'd be glad to have you, Banjo Haran.
Good, it's settled.
As you can see, my somewhat unreliable assistants come along too.
That's right, what about Elpeo Ple!?
She's been picked up. She's resting in the infirmary.
We'll have to tell Judau.
Ow ow...
...Someone's still alive!?
Geez, what was that all of a sudden?
Kiki!? Kiki Rosita!?
Huh? ...Shiro? Shiro!
Lieutenant Amada, who's that girl...?
She's with the neutral guerrillas. ...Kiki, what happened?
Well... we swiped a Zeon mobile suit, truck and all.
Then right after, we got snatched up, truck and all...
and just a little while ago, they dumped me here.
Either way, looks like the timing worked out.
You said it. Oh, right, there's no pilot for it,
so that MS is just sitting there. Take it with you!
That helps. We're short on mobile suits right now... What model is it?
Um, let's see, hmm... Something about a fighter...
A Kampfer!
Zeon's assault type, huh.
All right, Commander Hazuki, let's haul it in and withdraw ourselves.
Hey, hey, Shiro! You're not leaving me behind, are you!?
Huh? Yeah, I know. I'll drop you off somewhere safe.
You're popular, Lieutenant Amada.
...Don't tease me.
